title: a step's two connectors, each answered on its own
line: a search step at two connectors is asked at both; one's none run and the other's error on the same fields leave the step runnable at the source that did not answer alone, and a dry run says so; asked again, only that source is asked, and its none run closes the step; a run by the step's id asks every connector again

steps.say: a city-directory step on the home person's grandmother with WikiTree planted beside the Archive's directories as a second source, and the fields both connectors want: the towns her events name for the directories, a birth year for WikiTree, as the live runner asked them
run once: the Archive's own answer to that very search, which holds nothing, and WikiTree's connection timing out

answers.error: the harness's stand-in for no answer: timed out

expect.why: both connectors asked, one log row each: the Archive's none, WikiTree's error
the step stays runnable: WikiTree did not answer on these fields, though the Archive did

steps.say: a dry run says which source the step would ask

expect.why: the Archive answered none on these very fields and is not asked; WikiTree is, with its one request

steps.say: run again: only WikiTree is asked (an Archive request would be a failure of the fake), and its own answer to that very search holds nothing

expect.why: one more row, WikiTree's none; the Archive's run stands alone
every source has answered on these fields: the step is closed until the plan changes them
none runs leave the step planned

steps.say: the plan writes new fields on it: both sources are to ask again
a dry run by the step's id asks every connector again, whatever answered
